objective: Proofs: on every parity base delta = least circuit through the pair minus two (bond distance minus one); on knot trees delta = steps apart under parity, not-all-equal and mixtures, with the exact identity kappa = (-1/3)^a; separated four-sets on not-all-equal trees; the switching obstruction (a split line is a circle up to flipping values; |C| and every |kappa| fold).
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): the cumulant distance delta(x,y) = min over S containing both of (|S|-2) - log_3 |kappa_S| (clamped) is invariant under renaming and switching values; one knot is distance one under each law; on every parity base delta = least circuit - 2 = bond distance - 1; on parity knot trees delta = steps apart; on mixed chains kappa({ends} + parity pendants) = (-1/3)^a; separated four-sets never shortcut on NAE trees; up to switching a split line is a ring.
title: The cumulant distance: what is proved
